# Syncthing Block Exchange Protocol schema

This directory vendors the upstream Syncthing Block Exchange Protocol schema.
It is kept separate from Syncpeer's MIT-licensed source code so its origin and
license remain explicit.

- Upstream project: https://github.com/syncthing/syncthing
- Upstream release: `v2.1.2`
- Upstream commit: `44cbfcad56db30ccccdbbab40124fc498ee354db`
- Original file: `proto/bep/bep.proto`
- SHA-256: `cde1decf4d845d676655bf2f260d98be08f261f5b5cbb60924abcb9dfdec4575`
- License: Mozilla Public License 2.0 (`MPL-2.0`)

`proto/bep.proto` is an unmodified copy from that release. Do not edit it as
Syncpeer-owned source. Update it from a deliberate upstream release and record
the new release, commit, and checksum here.

The MPL applies to the vendored Syncthing files in this directory. It does not
change the MIT license of Syncpeer's independently written files.
